title: LegalProvision
description: Schema cho LegalProvision (docs/00 §8.3, docs/03 §3.9.4). Mot row = mot provision version; unique key vat ly la (provision_id, version) (docs/03:1087). 20 field goc theo FR-03 + node_kind (docs/03:1289).

provision_id.$comment: Stable & reproducible id (docs/00:396, docs/03 §3.8.5): {loai-van-ban}-{so}-{nam}__dieu-{n}__khoan-{n}__diem-{chu-cai}, vi du nd-168-2024__dieu-7__khoan-4__diem-b. Chuan hoa (docs/03:1080-1088): lowercase; bo dau trong ID tru ky tu đ (giu nguyen); thay khoang trang bang '-'; version KHONG nam trong id logic. Nhan Điem giu nguyen ky tu tieng Viet trong ID bao gom ca đ: Điem đ) -> diem-đ, Điem d) -> diem-d (khong va cham, docs/03:1041). Node ngoai cay Đieu thuong (docs/03:1090-1098): __phu-luc-{n}, __phu-luc-{n}__bang-{m}, __dieu-{n}__bang-{m}, __dieu-{n}__khoan-chuyen-tiep, __chuyen-tiep-{k}, __tieu-de-{n}. Grammar: mot trong cac nhanh ro rang — cay thuong (dieu -> khoan -> diem) theo thu tu, hoac cac dang non-tree rieng.

source_text.description: Noi dung phap ly thuoc truc tiep provision, giu nguyen van ban goc (docs/00:394); bat bien sau enrichment (docs/03:1289)

retrieval_text.description: Co the ke thua ngu canh cha khi phuc vu retrieval; trich dan van tro toi provision thuc te (docs/00:395, 409)

effective_from.description: Ngay bat dau hieu luc; nullable khi hieu luc chua xac dinh/chua review (docs/03:1272, 3.15.6)

status.description: Vong doi phap ly cua provision, doc lap voi review_status (docs/00:398)

review_status.$comment: Trang thai review corpus, la cong gate cua corpus (docs/00:398, 8.6); doc lap voi status (vong doi phap ly). Schema cho phep toan bo enum PENDING/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/DROPPED va KHONG loai bo row non-ACCEPTED; rang buoc ACCEPTED chi xuat hien o logic gate (docs/03:1272).
review_status.description: Trang thai review corpus (PENDING/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/DROPPED); schema khong loai bo non-ACCEPTED

allOf.description: Khi ca hai effective_from/effective_to co gia tri: effective_to phai > effective_from (docs/00 §8.3, docs/03:1272). JSON Schema draft-07 khong the so sanh giua hai thuoc tinh; rang buoc duoc thuc thi boi custom keyword x-effective-interval (xem backend/tests/test_legal_provision_schema.py) va CHECK constraint o tang DB.
